facts.fact: 使者在车站站台等候 Max 所在列车的进站
facts.quote: Envoys were waiting at the station platform when our train pulled in.

facts.fact: Max 担心假继承人出现后能压制她对冷铁的控制，让更多恶魔越过帷幕
facts.quote: The Coldiron within would obey my command and prevent more demons from crossing over, unless the false heir showed up and countered me.

facts.fact: Drakken 留守 Greyhold 守住东部边境，等待其他要塞的增援
facts.quote: The dragon prince had stayed behind at Greyhold to hold the eastern border until reinforcements arrived from the other forts.

facts.fact: Nikolai 顶着正午日光亲自到站台迎接，因为吸血鬼在正午最脆弱
facts.quote: At noon, even the most powerful among them were at their most vulnerable. Yet their prince had come to meet us in person.

facts.fact: 列车停稳后 Nikolai 走下楼梯，只向 Max 伸出手
facts.quote: Then Nikolai was there at the bottom of the stairs, hand extended.

facts.fact: Max 握住 Nikolai 的手，全场目光都落在她身上，她把下巴抬平
facts.quote: Heads turned. Every set of eyes landed on me, and I held my chin level.

facts.fact: Caspian 把手臂搭上 Max 的肩膀宣示占有，说车已经在等
facts.quote: The shifter prince dropped his arm around my shoulders with easy possessiveness.

facts.fact: Max 坐在 Nikolai 的车里、夹在两位王子中间，看着丹佛出现在挡风玻璃外
facts.quote: I sat between two princes on a bench seat built for three and watched Denver come into view through the windshield.

relations: Nikolai 与 Caspian 长期敌对（吸血鬼与狼），在站台当众针锋相对
Caspian 当众把 Max 揽在臂弯宣示占有
Nikolai 当众向 Max 伸手，放弃军阶礼节
Aelindor 从不干预 Caspian 对 Max 的公开宣示，也默许 Nikolai 与 Max 的关系
Drakken 留守 Greyhold 守住东部边境，等候其他要塞的增援
Frost 下车时一直跟在 Max 身后一步
Max 是冷铁（Coldiron）的操控者，假继承人可以压制她的命令
numbers: a bench seat built for three
